title: Visualization: Counter-Strike 2 Performance Dashboard
pitch: An interactive dashboard that turns raw CS2 match data into visual performance trends.
description: An interactive visualization of my own Counter-Strike 2 performance data, built for CSE 564 Visualization to turn raw match statistics into readable trends across maps, rounds, and situations instead of a spreadsheet of numbers. The project was later adopted as an example for future students on the course website.
